values.en: The three coefficients $e,f,g$ are also commonly written $L,M,N$. This text uses lowercase $e,f,g$ to avoid confusing the last coefficient with the chosen vector field $\boldsymbol N$. All three depend on the normal choice.
values.zh-CN: 三个系数 $e,f,g$ 常写作 $L,M,N$。本文采用小写 $e,f,g$，避免第三个标量系数与选定的向量场 $\boldsymbol N$ 混淆。三个系数均依赖法向的选择。
